# Vipin V's Blog

> Blogs by Vipin V on tech, ideas, memories, projects and travel.

Vipin writes personal posts about technology, projects, travel, food and everyday life. There is no fixed niche or publishing schedule. Articles are published with the Wisp CMS and render in full on this website at /blog/{slug}. Reading times are estimates at 200 words per minute.

## Pages
- [Blogs](https://blog.vipinv.dev/): Recent articles with titles, publication dates, tags and estimated reading times. Search and pagination are available.
- [About Vipin](https://blog.vipinv.dev/about): The author's own introduction and interests.
- [Sitemap](https://blog.vipinv.dev/sitemap.xml): Every public page, including all published articles.
